'''Brokeface''' is a [[goblin raider bosses|goblin raider boss]] that can be summoned after slaying 15 [[goblin]]s within the [[Goblin Village]]. He uses [[melee]] attacks. Upon arrival he shouts "Stabbin' time!" and other phrases. This goblin boss will always drop a piece of equipment and one other non-equippable item.

** A number of early-game mobs will once again drop actual armour, weapons, ores, and bars.

*** Small spiky bronze salvage → Bronze spear
*** Small bladed bronze salvage → Bronze scimitar/Bronze off hand scimitar
*** Small plated bronze salvage → Bronze full helm
*** Small plated iron salvage → Iron square shield
*** Tiny plated steel salvage → Steel med helm
*** Small plated steel salvage → Steel full helm
*** Medium plated steel salvage → Steel chainbody
*** Huge plated steel salvage → Steel platebody
*** Medium bladed steel salvage → Steel battleaxe/Steel off hand battleaxe
